lines.beaver: 치료 끝났어요. 지금 입 안은 어때요?
lines.beaver_en: The treatment is done. How does your mouth feel now?
lines.learner: 조금 아파요. 주사 맞았을 때 많이 아팠어요.
lines.en: It hurts a little. It hurt a lot when I got the shot.
lines.roman: jogeum apayo. jusa majasseul ttae mani apasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그 주사 때문에 그래요. 곧 괜찮아질 거예요.
lines.beaver_en: That's because of the shot. It'll be fine soon.
lines.beaver_roman: geu jusa ttaemune geuraeyo. got gwaenchanajil geoyeyo.
lines.en: That's a relief. Did the surgery go well?

lines.beaver: 네, 잘 됐어요. 이를 하나 뺐어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it went well. We pulled one tooth.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, jal dwaesseoyo. ireul hana ppaesseoyo.
lines.learner: 언제 다 나아요? 빨리 낫고 싶어요.
lines.en: When will it fully heal? I want to get better soon.
lines.roman: eonje da naayo? ppalli natgo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: It should heal in about a week.
lines.en: I don't need to be hospitalized?

lines.beaver_en: You can go straight home today.
lines.learner: 작년에 다리 수술했을 때 열흘 뒤에 퇴원했어요.
lines.en: When I had leg surgery last year, I left the hospital ten days later.
lines.roman: jangnyeone dari susuraesseul ttae yeolheul dwie toewonhaesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 이 수술은 간단해요. 두세 시간 동안 먹지 마세요.
lines.beaver_en: This surgery is simple. Don't eat for two or three hours.
lines.beaver_roman: i susureun gandanhaeyo. duse sigan dongan meokjji maseyo.
lines.en: Okay, I see. I'll write it down.

lines.beaver: 그리고 오늘은 뜨거운 음식을 먹지 마세요.
lines.beaver_en: Also, don't eat hot food today.
lines.beaver_roman: geurigo oneureun tteugeoun eumsigeul meokjji maseyo.
lines.learner: 저는 소화가 잘 안 돼요. 소화제 먹어도 돼요?
lines.en: I don't digest well. Can I take digestive medicine?
lines.roman: jeoneun sohwaga jal an dwaeyo. sohwaje meogeodo dwaeyo?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, digestive medicine is fine. I'll give you painkillers too.
lines.learner: 어렸을 때 치과에 오면 많이 울었어요.
lines.en: When I was little, I cried a lot at the dentist.
lines.roman: eoryeosseul ttae chikkwae omyeon mani ureosseoyo.

lines.learner: 선생님 덕분이에요. 주의 사항 잘 지킬게요.
lines.en: Thanks to you. I'll follow the instructions carefully.
lines.roman: seonsaengnim deokbunieyo. juui sahang jal jikilkkeyo.

lines.beaver: 오늘은 여기까지 할게요. 다음 주에 오세요.
lines.beaver_en: That's all for today. Come back next week.
lines.beaver_roman: oneureun yeogikkaji halkkeyo. daeum jue oseyo.
